name: Sons of the Nomad
lore: The Legion of the Nomad refuses to be chained to any fortress or timeline. Their Primal Nomad rides the lightning between moments — strike, vanish, strike again — until the enemy's lines are a map of empty dust and broken plans.

rules.name: Lightning Road
rules.lore: Speed is the Nomad's creed. Where others dig trenches, the Sons of the Nomad open roads of storm and leave only thunder in their wake.
rules.text: +Shattered Legions+ units from your army can Shoot after making an Advance move. In addition, +Shattered Legions+ units from your army that have the +Mounted+ or +Vehicle+ keyword can Charge after making an Advance move.

strategems.name: Storm Dash
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, add 2" to the target unit's =person-running= Movement trait, and it can re-roll Advance rolls.

strategems.name: Hit and Fade
strategems.when: After a friendly +Shattered Legions+ unit has completed its Shoot attacks
strategems.effect: The target unit can make a Normal move of up to 6". It cannot Charge this Battle Round.

strategems.name: Outflank Gale
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, the target unit can Fall Back and still Shoot and Charge, and enemy units cannot fire Overwatch against it.

spells.name: Windwhisper
spells.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, one friendly +Legion of the Nomad+ unit within 18" of this +Psyker+ can Shoot and Charge after making a Fall Back move.

spells.name: Sky-Bolt Path
spells.effect: Select one friendly +Shattered Legions+ unit within 12". Until the end of the Battle Round, when that unit Advances, do not roll — it Advances 6" instead.

spells.name: Dust Veil
spells.effect: Select one friendly +Shattered Legions+ unit within 12". Until the end of the Battle Round, ranged attacks against that unit suffer -1 to Hit, and the unit can move through enemy models when it makes a Normal or Advance move (it cannot end that move within Melee Distance of enemy models).

upgrades.name: Road Scion
upgrades.text: At the start of the battle, gain 1 CP.

upgrades.name: Storm-Runner
upgrades.text: Your +Warlord+ has +2" to its =person-running= Movement trait.

upgrades.name: Master of the Lightning Road
upgrades.text: Your +Warlord+ and models in its attached unit (if any) can Shoot and Charge after making an Advance move.
